# PlayIDE (EIJA Studio)

> PlayIDE is an open-source (Apache-2.0) UML workbench for software engineers who already read UML. When an AI or a person proposes a change to a supported workflow, PlayIDE shows it as a visual UML diff, follows its effects to related diagrams, screens, laws and checks, and builds a local app (React UI, HTTP API, SQLite) you can run beside the diagram. AI proposes, the kernel checks, the owner decides. It is a working local preview written in Python 3.11+, not a hosted service.

Key facts:

- Product name: PlayIDE. Repository, Python package and command: `eija-studio` / `eija`. EIJA means Executable Intent and Journey Assurance.
- Runs locally: `pip install -e ".[dev]"` then `eija serve --pack packs/library-loan --open`. Loopback, SQLite, no telemetry by default. No Node or frontend build needed.
- "UML as code" here means supported model elements (states, transitions, roles, guards, laws) have executable semantics; one deterministic kernel decides whether an action is allowed. Unsupported constructs stay design-only.
- Approval and activation are separate, explicit owner actions. Law, vocabulary, data-schema, screen and scenario edits never silently become active policy.
- The built-in chat plan mode is an offline phrase reader, not a live model. Live provider calls (OpenRouter, Codex) need explicit opt-in.
- Imports supported PlantUML, XMI, Mermaid and draw.io forms and reports what it could not carry.
- Ships eleven bundled systems, including five sector packs: specialist referral (healthcare), card payment, parcel delivery, SaaS subscription and building permit.
- Not yet done: general live AI creation, value-driven actions, data migrations, connected multi-workflow delivery and production identity.
